evidence_status: Published aggregate transcriptions, derived means and separately identified synthetic accounts; no new field observations.

intermediate_class.source: Vasquez and Arellano (2012), arXiv:1208.0248, Table 170, printed page 942
intermediate_class.class_definition_note: Table 170 defines class II as 10-30 cm; the abstract's alternative 10-20 cm wording is not silently substituted.
intermediate_class.mass_method: Biomass estimated using selected Chave et al. relationships; tissue carbon fractions measured separately. This is evidence about the reported class distribution, not independent validation of the architecture-informed pantropical stock.

architectural_source: Arellano-P. and Rangel-Ch., arXiv:1508.03667v2, Table 1. These are reported biomass outputs, not carbon kilograms or new weighed measurements.

synthetic_annual_accounts.case: Omitted forest release included, other terms fixed
Larger forest attribution, same source total and removals

synthetic_units: Common carbon-mass units per year; not measured global emissions or a fitted atmospheric model.

delay_example.note: Prescribed illustrative retention is not an empirical airborne fraction; all fractions refer to one non-overlapping carbon cohort.
